version_mismatch.label: update
version_mismatch.title: The app just updated
version_mismatch.description: A new version of Sanar y Criar was released while this page was open, so it briefly fell out of sync. Reloading will pick up the latest version.

chunk_load.label: loading
chunk_load.title: Part of the page didn't load
chunk_load.description: Your browser was holding onto an older copy of the app and couldn't load a piece of it. A quick reload usually clears it right up.

auth_session.label: session
auth_session.title: Your session expired
auth_session.description: You've been signed out or your sign-in needs refreshing. Logging back in will restore your access.

plan_limit.label: plan
plan_limit.title: This feature isn't available
plan_limit.description: The feature you tried to use isn't included on the current plan, or it's turned off. Enabling it or upgrading the plan unlocks access.

permission.label: permission
permission.title: You don't have access to this
permission.description: Your account doesn't have permission for this page or action. If you think that's a mistake, write to us and we'll look into it.

rate_limit.label: rate limit
rate_limit.title: Let's slow down for a moment
rate_limit.description: You've made a lot of requests in a short time, so we've paused things briefly to keep your account safe. It'll free up shortly.

not_found.label: not found
not_found.title: We couldn't find that
not_found.description: It may have been moved or deleted, or it may no longer be available. It's not something you did wrong.

conflict.label: conflict
conflict.title: That already exists
conflict.description: This conflicts with something that's already there: for example, an account or item with the same name or email already exists.

validation.label: validation
validation.title: Something needs a quick fix
validation.description: A field is missing, out of range, or in the wrong format. Adjust the highlighted input and try again.

org_config.label: setup
org_config.title: This workspace needs setup
org_config.description: This organization isn't fully configured yet. It needs to be set up before it can be used.

payment.label: payment
payment.title: We couldn't complete the payment
payment.description: Something interrupted the payment or the subscription change. You can safely try again; if you see a charge you don't recognize, write to us.

upload.label: upload
upload.title: That upload didn't go through
upload.description: Your file may be too large or in an unsupported format, or the connection dropped mid-upload. Check the file and give it another try.

ai.label: AI
ai.title: The AI assistant ran into trouble
ai.description: An AI request was interrupted or returned an incomplete response. These can be temporary, so trying again often works.

offline.label: offline
offline.title: You appear to be offline
offline.description: We couldn't reach our servers, which usually means a network hiccup on the way. Check your connection and try again.

service_unavailable.label: service
service_unavailable.title: A service is temporarily down
service_unavailable.description: A feature we rely on isn't responding or hasn't been set up yet. It's on our side and usually clears on its own.

timeout.label: timeout
timeout.title: That took too long
timeout.description: The request timed out before it finished. The server may be busy; trying again usually works.

server.label: server
server.title: We hit a snag on our end
server.description: Our servers returned an unexpected error while handling your request. This is on us, not you; trying again in a moment usually helps.

unknown.label: unknown
unknown.title: Something didn't go as planned
unknown.description: We ran into an unexpected problem completing your request. It's been logged and is likely temporary; trying again often clears it. If it keeps happening, tell us what you were doing.

sc_errors.fallback_description: We ran into an error and it's been logged. Retrying or heading home usually helps.

report_dialog.title: Tell us what happened
report_dialog.subtitle: Your report goes straight to our team so we can fix it.
report_dialog.name: Name
report_dialog.comments: What were you doing when this happened?
report_dialog.success: We got your report. Thank you!

not_found_page.heading: We couldn't find this page
not_found_page.description: It may have moved, or the link may have a typo. From the home page you can see the courses and ebooks.

org_not_found.title: Enter your organization
org_not_found.description: Enter your organization name to continue to the login page.
org_not_found.help: Don't know your organization name? Ask whoever manages your account.

org_inactive.title: This organization is no longer active
org_inactive.description: This workspace has been deactivated. If you think that's a mistake, write to us.
